notes.title: The Risers Update
notes.content:
Hi.

We want to inform that we are doing a patch for The Risers and it will be finished soon.

Here is the next fixes:
	-Two new normal air attacks for Lord Austin
	-Two new normal air attacks for Sir.
	-Two new normal air attacks for Thalasinus.
	-Two new normal air attacks for Mr. Wyndi.
	-Two new normal air attacks for Akin.
	-An issue fixed for Fydora's attack when she's rolling.
	-An issue fixed for Allegra's Hyper attack.
	-All characters's hypers can be executed with two buttons of the rest of six attack buttons.
	-Sir's Stage improves.
	-Some game's interface changes.

We apologize for our late update. We are new and only two developers. And actually, we are working in a new game that we are expecting finish
and publish it next year. However, we'll be aware for any another fix for the The Risers.
If you find any bug or issue, please let us know.

NOTE: For ethic reasons, The Risers ONLY can be launched from Steam. Otherwise, if The Risers is executed out
of Steam, it will not be launched. 

Thank you very much and Kind Regards.
